comparison.objective: Candidate installs and secures a load-bearing rack rail; record selects a wrench, releases a captive nut, and opens an arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs long-part bimanual leveling, spring-prong latching at two posts, telescoping, then screw driving; record tests wrench-fit discrimination and torque without rounding.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four prongs, full spring extension, matched rack units, bottom-hole screws, release, and 3 s retention; record requires >60° nut backoff, arm >=85°, damage avoidance, and 20 s hands-off.
comparison.reason: Different mechanism and tested ability. Candidate lacks measured insertion-force, deformation, thread, and pose tolerances; those omissions do not make this wrench-release task a plausible duplicate.
